reading.body:
Meta owns a data center campus in Fort Worth, Tarrant County. No power capacity is published for this facility. Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities overall, of which 18 publish megawatt figures totaling 468 MW. This campus does not appear in those 18 published figures, placing it outside the ranked capacity tier despite verified Meta ownership.

The research record for this site is exhausted. Location, address, and ownership are verified as of September 2026. Opening date, investment, building count, and power consumption are not published by Meta for this specific facility. Regional Wikipedia sources for Fort Worth and Tarrant County either omit the facility entirely or contain only generic Meta company-level information. Direct operator spec pages have not been consulted for detailed campus specifications.

Meta's data center program spans multiple facilities across the United States, including a separate 10 billion dollar AI data center project in northeast Louisiana announced in December 2024. Whether the Fort Worth campus will matter to AI scaling depends on published capacity figures that do not yet exist in accessible sources. Until Meta publishes specifications for this site, its role in the company's AI infrastructure and the state's overall compute capacity remains unknown.
